question: What result follows from burying this object in the place of cows?
premises: This object should be buried in the cow-station.
The action is prescribed as a ritual act.
The stated result is the increase of cows.
inference: Burying this in the cow-station leads to the increase of cows.
plain_english: One should bury this in the cow-station; then there will be an increase of cows.
